S78.01.needs: an account where voice input is switched off or not on its plan
S78.01.note: The resolver is the capability_refusal function used by /voice and /skills. It is not a single screen.
steps: Sign in to an account where voice input is switched off or not on its plan.
Type /voice and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: a line saying Voice input is not available, which names the reason.
S78.01.where: No control of its own. Effect shows as a refusal line such as "Voice input is not available ..." from /voice, or an empty /skills list, when the account's switch is off.

S78.02.needs: a signed-in account with a model list that includes reasoning and non-reasoning models
S78.02.note: Only the effort row was traced. Attachment and thinking controls in the composer by model were not found.
steps: Type /model and press Enter.
Highlight a model that supports reasoning (marked R in agi models list). Look for the Effort: row under the list.
Highlight a model that does not support reasoning.
Compare with Expected: the Effort: row should appear or disappear with the model. The status bar effort: label also disappears for non-reasoning models.
S78.02.where: /model, then move the highlight between models that do and do not support reasoning.

labels.text: switch to a vision model with /model first

S78.03.needs: an image file, and a non-vision model in the model list
S78.03.note: The image-check message is in the attach path function; the default branch of /attach that routes a file path there was not traced line by line. The message does not name which model to use.
steps: Type /model, pick a model with no vision support (no V in agi models list).
Type /attach followed by the path to a PNG or JPG file, and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: a message that the model does not accept images and asks you to switch to a vision model with /model first.
Switch to a vision model and attach the same file. Expected: the file is accepted.
S78.03.where: /model to pick a model that cannot read images, then /attach with an image file path.

labels.text: This model takes no effort setting on this route

S78.04.needs: a signed-in account with reasoning and non-reasoning models
S78.04.note: The notice that the level is not sent to the model is text from claude_parity.rs. The code that strips unsupported levels from the outgoing request (streaming.rs) moved and was not confirmed.
steps: Type /model and pick a model that supports reasoning.
Type /effort and press Enter. The effort picker opens.
Choose a level with the arrow keys and Enter. Expected: Effort set to <level>.
Switch to a model that takes no effort setting and type /effort. Expected: the effort row and the /effort command are no longer offered.
S78.04.where: /model to pick a reasoning model, then /effort.

labels.text: does not accept a temperature, so your configured

S78.05.needs: a model that rejects temperature; none was listed in the code for this check
S78.05.note: The --temperature flag was read from the lib.rs struct and its doc comment, not from the flag definition.
steps: Run agi --temperature 0.5 (or set temperature under [default] in the config file).
Choose a model that rejects temperature (see the catalog). Start the chat.
Read the first system line in the chat. Expected: it says the model does not accept a temperature, so the configured value is not sent to it.
S78.05.where: agi --temperature <number>, then start a chat with a model that rejects sampling settings.

S78.06.needs: a signed-in account in Managed Cloud mode
S78.06.note: Which models offer which ratios was not checked. The quoted check in cloud/image.rs moved to unsupported_for_model.
steps: Make sure the session is in Managed mode (/privacy-mode managed). /image is only listed in Managed mode.
Type /image --aspect 16:9 a red bicycle and press Enter.
Choose a model that does not offer that ratio, if you know one. Read the reply. Expected: a message that the model does not make that ratio and lists the ratios it supports.
Type /image with no text to see the help line that lists the settings.
S78.06.where: /image with a flag, such as /image --aspect 16:9 <prompt>, in Managed Cloud mode.

labels.text: is unavailable on your plan right now.

S78.07.needs: a Free account (or a lower plan than a locked model)
S78.07.note: The second check, on the server, cannot be seen from the CLI. Only the visible refusal and the locked list were confirmed.
steps: Sign in with a plan that does not include some models.
Run agi models list in a terminal. Look for the Locked on your ... plan section.
Type /model, pick a locked model, and send a message. Expected: a reply that the model is unavailable on your plan right now.
Compare the server's refusal with the locked list. The check on the server was not run from the UI.
S78.07.where: agi models list (CLI command), and /model to pick a locked model.

labels.text: Run `agi usage` to see when the limit resets

S78.08.note: The account lines come from usage_summary.rs; the exact lines shown for remaining allowance were not traced.
steps: Sign in and send a message or two.
Type /usage and press Enter.
Read the account lines at the bottom of the reply. Expected: the plan allowance that remains, from the server.

S78.09.needs: a member account in a workspace with a policy
S78.09.note: Model and retention restrictions by workspace policy live in apps/web routes, not in a CLI screen. Only the connector policy was confirmed in the CLI.
steps: Sign in to a workspace account whose admin has set a connector policy.
Type /connectors and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: the policy is shown and restricted items are blocked.
S78.09.where: /connectors, which shows the workspace connector policy.

S78.12.needs: a Free account and an account outside the age rule
S78.12.note: Searched apps/cli/src for age, adult, eligibility and policy wording. No age check or eligibility text was found in the CLI sign-in code (oauth.rs). The web device page cited in the plan no longer has the matching text.

S78.15.needs: a machine with and without a local model runtime
S78.15.note: Checks for sandbox and CLI presence were not traced individually.
steps: Make sure no local model runtime is installed.
Run agi models list in a terminal. Expected: no INSTALLED LOCAL MODELS section appears.
Type /doctor and press Enter. Read the checks listed.
Install or start a local runtime, run agi models list again, and compare. Expected: the local models section appears.

labels.text: Temporarily unavailable, on your plan but not answering right now; try again later:
On your plan but not offered by this deployment right now:

S78.16.needs: a signed-in account; a model the server reports as temporarily unavailable is needed to see that group
S78.16.note: The server decides which group a model falls into; the tester cannot force each state.
steps: Sign in and run agi models list.
Look for the three groups: Temporarily unavailable, Locked on your ... plan, and On your plan but not offered by this deployment right now.
Compare the wording. Expected: each group has its own line that says why the model is not available.

S78.17.needs: a signed-in account that can switch between Managed and Local modes
S78.17.note: The /effort hiding rule is in command_applies_here in tui_app.rs.
steps: Type /privacy-mode managed, then type / to open the command popup. Note /image is listed.
Type /privacy-mode local, then type / again. Expected: /image is no longer listed.
Pick a model without reasoning and type / again. Expected: /effort is not listed.
S78.17.where: Type / in the composer to open the command list, after /privacy-mode managed and /privacy-mode local.

labels.text: (`agi plans` shows what each plan includes)

S78.18.note: Whether the model picker in /model shows locked rows as disabled was not confirmed.
steps: Sign in with a plan that does not include some models.
Run agi models list.
Look for the Locked on your ... plan section, which lists each model with the plan it needs.
Compare with Expected: restricted models stay listed and show the reason and the plan to upgrade to.
S78.18.where: agi models list (CLI command): models your plan does not include are listed with the plan they need.

labels.text: Run `agi plans` to see what each plan includes.

S78.19.needs: a Free account, to see a plan-locked feature
S78.19.note: The message for a plan-blocked request is in errors.rs; the server route that produces it was not run.
steps: Type /upgrade and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: Plans and upgrades: with the plans link.
Run agi plans in a terminal. Expected: the plans and what each includes are listed.
Try to use a plan-locked feature to see the Cloud chat requires message and its link.
S78.19.where: /upgrade (opens the plans page), and agi plans in a terminal.

labels.text: The agent wants to read the page open in your signed-in Chrome.

S78.21.needs: Chrome with the AGI browser bridge connected
S78.21.note: The connection steps for the browser bridge were not found in the code read.
steps: Connect the AGI browser bridge to your signed-in Chrome (the way to connect it was not traced).
Ask the agent to read the page open in Chrome.
Read the approval prompt. Expected: it says the agent wants to read the page open in your signed-in Chrome, and gives the target.
Deny or allow, and check that nothing happens without approval.
S78.21.where: Ask the agent to read or click in the active Chrome tab. The approval prompt appears before the action.

labels.text: switch to a vision model with /model first
Pick another model with `agi models list`, or try again later.

S78.22.needs: an image file, and a non-vision model
S78.22.note: The attach message does not name a model. The model-unavailable message names one only when a plan alternative exists.
steps: Type /model and pick a model with no V in agi models list.
Type /attach with an image path and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: it tells you to switch to a vision model with /model first.
Read the reply for a model-unavailable case: it names the alternative to use with /model.
S78.22.where: /model, then /attach with an image while a non-vision model is selected.

S78.23.needs: a signed-in account with a saved conversation
S78.23.note: The offer appears only when you type the command, not on its own when a task fits another device.
steps: Sign in and have a saved conversation in your account.
Type /continue-elsewhere and press Enter.
Read the reply. Expected: it says the conversation is in your account and gives a web link to continue it on the web, or in the desktop or mobile app.
Type /continue-elsewhere open to open the link in your browser.

S78.24.needs: a signed-in account; a BYOK provider key for the BYOK step
S78.24.note: The local model route is set with /model and a local model, not checked here.
steps: Type /privacy-mode and press Enter. Read the Privacy settings screen and its Active mode line.
Type /privacy-mode byok while in Local mode. Expected: Local -> BYOK requires an explicit reviewable handoff.
Use /byok to create a reviewed draft and send it. Expected: the handoff is shown before the send.
Type /privacy-mode with a wrong word to see the usage line.
S78.24.where: /privacy-mode (no argument shows the settings), then /privacy-mode byok or /privacy-mode managed.

labels.text: does not accept a temperature, so your configured

S78.26.note: Same effect as S78.05. The request-side removal is in streaming.rs effective_temperature and was not run.
steps: Set a temperature with agi --temperature 0.5 or in the config file.
Start a chat with a model that rejects temperature.
Read the first system line. Expected: it says the configured temperature is not sent to the model.
S78.26.where: No control of its own. Effect shows as a system line at the start of a chat when a temperature is set for a model that rejects it.

S78.28.needs: a plan change you can make on another device
S78.28.note: The 5-minute TTL is in tier_cache.rs. Whether /status forces a refresh was not confirmed.
steps: Note the plan shown in /status (Account: signed in, <plan> plan).
Change the plan on the web or another device.
Wait up to 5 minutes, then type /status again and compare the plan name.
S78.28.where: No control of its own. Plan changes show in /status after the 5-minute tier cache refreshes, without restarting the CLI.
